subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload path, and what auth, storage, validation, overwrite, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with Control UI ergonomics, but it crosses a new file-upload and workspace-write boundary that automation should not define without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Upload Design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves existing avatar read protections.

options.title: Keep Existing Manual Paths
options.body: Continue supporting CLI/config/IDENTITY.md avatar strings and browser-local overrides while avoiding a new server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer Core Upload
options.body: Leave this open or close by maintainer decision until a broader Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Upload Design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves existing avatar read protections.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history signal across avatar serving, avatar hardening, and the surrounding Control UI/gateway code.
